WITH film_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    film_id,
    COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY film_id
),
total_copies AS (
  SELECT SUM(copy_count) AS total FROM film_counts
),
film_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    fc.film_id,
    fc.copy_count,
    fc.copy_count / tc.total AS share
  FROM film_counts fc
  CROSS JOIN total_copies tc
),
top_10 AS (
  SELECT 
    film_id,
    copy_count
  FROM film_shares
  ORDER BY copy_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  f.film_id,
  f.copy_count,
  f.share
FROM film_shares f
WHERE f.copy_count >= (
  SELECT MIN(copy_count) FROM top_10
)
ORDER BY f.share DESC
